Intel Confidential


These Terms and Conditions (“Terms and Conditions”) constitute a legal agreement between your Company and its majority owned subsidiaries (hereafter “Company”, “You” “Your”) and Intel Corporation and its subsidiaries (“Intel”).

By accepting these Terms and Conditions or by accepting any of the benefits provided via the Intel Deal Registration system (“System”), you will be confirming that your Company has authorized you to enter into these Terms and Conditions with Intel, on behalf of your Company, and that your Company agrees to enter into these Terms and Conditions with Intel.


Introduction

The System provides You with a convenient tool to register end customer deals with Intel and to obtain supporting benefits from Intel to assist you in selling to that customer. The provision of benefits is determined solely at the discretion of Intel’s Sales and Marketing Organization, and is subject to these Terms and Conditions and the terms contained in the individual quote letter describing the benefits offered for a particular deal (“Quote Letter”) which may take the form of a rebate, or other non-financial benefits.


1.    Deal Entry. You are responsible for entering a new deal which You are pursuing (“Entered Deal”), according to instructions in the System. Information that will be provided about the Entered Deal includes, but is not limited to, the name of the end customer, the Intel products involved, a detailed Entered Deal description, and defined Entered Deal start and end dates, as well as the name of the relevant OEM, the name of the partners’ competitor and the product they are offering as well as the name of the OEM underlying the partner’s product offering. 

 

2.    Email Notification of Approval and Benefits Provided. You will be notified by the System administration, via a system generated email, when an Entered Deal is approved, and becomes an Approved Opportunity. You will receive a Quote Letter, describing the benefits, financial or otherwise, which Intel will provide to You to support Your Approved Opportunity. No other communication, written or verbal, constitutes approval including discussion or communication with any Intel Employee. Benefits will be provided pursuant to the terms of that Quote Letter, which will provide specifics regarding products, customer, project, and dates, on which the provided benefit will be conditional. Failure to abide by these Terms and Conditions or the terms of the Quote Letter will result in denial of benefits. 


3.     Modifications. Benefits provided can be modified, changed, or terminated at Intel’s discretion, upon the delivery of a new, updated Quote Letter. You may request modifications to the Approved Opportunity, and Intel may accept these modifications or changes, in its sole discretion. If a modification or termination is accepted, an updated Quote Letter will be provided to You.  


4.    Approved Opportunity Win/Loss. You are responsible to communicate whether you have won or lost a particular Approved Opportunity, via the System. You must provide proof of performance, as instructed by the System.    


5.    Confidentiality. You are required to keep these Terms and Conditions, the terms and conditions of the Quote Letter, and all benefits provided confidential, subject to Your Corporate Non-Disclosure Agreement (CNDA) with Intel, or the confidentiality obligations of the Terms and Conditions of the Intel Partner Alliance, as appropriate.


6.    Program Rights Reserved. Intel reserves the right to alter or cancel any or all aspects relative to the Deal Registration initiative, at any time, without prior notice. In the event of alterations or cancellations, Approved Opportunities for which You have already received a Quote Letter, will not be affected, unless you receive a new Quote Letter with updated terms.


7.     Audit and Offsetting. Intel reserves the right to audit and verify all claim requests and request additional proof of performance documentation.  The provision of benefits is at the discretion of Intel and is based on the requirements outlined in these Terms and Conditions.  Without prejudice to any right or remedy available to Intel under these Terms and Conditions, at law or otherwise, Intel will have the right at any time to set off any liability of Company to Intel resulting from failure to comply with any Deal Registration initiative requirements, submission of inaccurate information to Intel, or abuse of the program, against any liability of Intel to You (including, without limitation, any rebate due to You from Intel), and irrespective of the currency of its denomination, unless such set off is prohibited under applicable local law. If the liabilities to be set off are expressed in different currencies, Intel may convert either liability at a market rate of exchange for the purpose of set off. For the purposes of this sub-Section 3.2 only: (i) “Intel” means the Intel legal entity entering into these Terms and Conditions, its direct and indirect subsidiaries, its ultimate parent company and the latter’s direct and indirect subsidiaries; (ii) “Company” means the Company legal entity entering into these Terms and Conditions, its direct and indirect subsidiaries, its ultimate parent company and the latter’s direct and indirect subsidiaries.


8.    Password. You are required to keep Your System password secure and confidential and use it only for Your authorized access to the System. You are solely responsible for all activities that occur with Your password. You agree to notify Intel immediately of any actual or suspected unauthorized use of Your password. Intel is not responsible for any consequences that result from any unauthorized use of Your password.


9.     Legal Compliance. You will fulfill any and all Approved Opportunity in compliance with any applicable law, regulation and generally accepted code of conduct in the execution territory. This includes determining whether the Approved Opportunity can actually be carried out at all in compliance with applicable law or regulation.


10.    Termination. Intel may terminate Your use of the System, and these Terms and Conditions, at any time and for any reason by providing You notice of termination at least fourteen (14) days prior to the effective date of the termination. You may terminate Your use of the System, and Your agreement to these Terms and Conditions at any time by providing written notice to Intel.  Upon termination, all rights and benefits granted to You under these Terms and Conditions, will cease immediately, and You will immediately comply with all termination obligations specified in these Terms and Conditions and other applicable notices. If Intel determines, in its sole discretion, that you have not complied with either these Terms and Conditions or those of the applicable Quote Letter, Intel may withhold or recall benefits provided to you and may terminate Your use of the System, and these Terms and Conditions, immediately upon notice to You.


11.    Product Supply. By agreeing to these Terms and Conditions, Intel does not commit or guarantee product supply to You. You will follow the Intel standard order process to gain Intel’s acknowledgement of product supply. Furthermore, the Intel standard terms and conditions of sale, including without limitation warranties and indemnities, will not be affected by these Terms and Conditions. Intel specifically rejects acceptance of any conflicting term and condition.


12.    Taxes. Each party is responsible for its own respective income taxes or taxes based upon gross revenues, including, but not limited to, business and occupation taxes. You are responsible for any and all applicable taxes related to Your receipt of any Intel benefits, including but not limited to any sales, use, goods and services, services, consumption, business, value added, or other taxes or comparable levies, transaction privilege taxes, gross receipts taxes, net receipt taxes, any withholding taxes and other charges such as duties, customs, tariffs, imposts, contributions and other government imposed surcharges.


13.    Disclaimers. THE SYSTEM IS PROVIDED AT NO CHARGE FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE, WITH NO WARRANTY WHATSOEVER FROM INTEL AND ITS SUPPLIERS. INTEL DISCLAIMS ANY AND ALL WARRANTIES EXPRESSED, IMPLIED, OR OTHERWISE, WITH RESPECT TO THE SYSTEM INCLUDING ANY WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY, SATISFACTORY QUALITY, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, OR ANY WARRANTY OF NONINFRINGEMENT. IN ADDITION, INTEL DOES NOT WARRANT THE CONTINUOUS OR UNINTERRUPTED ACCESS TO THE SYSTEM OR THE OPERATION, FUNCTIONALITY, OR AVAILABILITY OF THE SYSTEM, OR THAT THE SYSTEM WILL BE VIRUS FREE, OR THAT ANY DEFECTS IN THE SYSTEM WILL BE CORRECTED.

 14.1  Intel will have no liability to You for any of the following losses or damage (whether such losses or damage were foreseen, foreseeable, known or otherwise): loss of revenue; loss of actual or anticipated profits; loss of the use of money; loss of anticipated savings; loss of business; loss of opportunity; loss of goodwill; loss of reputation; loss of, damage to or corruption of data; or any indirect or consequential loss or damage howsoever caused (including, for the avoidance of doubt, where such loss or damage is of the type specified in this sub-Section), whether under theory of contract, tort (including negligence), strict liability, or otherwise related to these Terms and Conditions.


 14.2   Subject to sub-Section 14.1 above, the aggregate liability of Intel under these Terms and Conditions [whether for negligence (or any other tortious act or omission), breach of contract or otherwise] will in no circumstance exceed 100% of the total amount paid or to be paid by Intel to You under the individual Approved Opportunities which gave rise to the loss or damage.


 14.3  Nothing in these Terms and Conditions excludes or limits Intel’s liability for fraud or other criminal acts; the tort of deceit; death or personal injury caused by Intel’s breach of duty; or any other liability that cannot be excluded by law.


15.    Anti-corruption: You represent and warrant that, neither You nor anyone acting on Your behalf has not and will not violate any applicable anti-corruption law, including but not limited to: The US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, the UK Bribery Act, and/or similar laws in other jurisdictions (the “Anti-Corruption Laws”) in relation to any Activity. Customer further represents and warrants that neither You nor anyone acting on Your behalf has or will directly or indirectly through any other person or entity, offer, pay, give, promise, solicit or authorize the payment of any money, gift, or anything of value to any government official (which includes any officer, employee or person acting in an official capacity for (1) any government department, agency or instrumentality, (2) any state-owned or state-controlled company, (3) any public international organization, (4) any political party, political party official, or candidate for political office, and (5) any agent or intermediary of any of the foregoing) (“Government Official”) or any other person while knowing or having reason to know that all or a portion of such money, gift, or thing of value will be offered, paid, or given directly or indirectly to any Government Official for the purpose of (1) improperly influencing any act or decision of the Government Official in his or her official capacity, (2) improperly inducing the Government Official to perform or not perform any act that violates the lawful duty of such official, or (3) securing an improper advantage, or (4) improperly inducing the Government Official to use his or her influence to affect or influence any act or decision of a government or instrumentality in order to assist Intel or any of its affiliates in obtaining or retaining business. You agree that if You learn of or suspect any such payment, promise, transfer or offer, in connection with any Activity, You will immediately disclose it in writing to Intel. 1. Activities involving Government Official For any Activities including a Government Official or for any Activities where a Government Official may receive a payment, fee (e.g., speaker or consulting fees) or anything of value, You agree to comply with the following rules: (1) You will not provide, nor allow any other party to provide, cash or cash equivalent gifts to a Government Official or government agency except as a reasonable remuneration (e.g. reasonable speaker fees) or reimbursement on reasonable expenses; and (2) You will ensure any payments (or anything of value provided to any government agency or Government Official) will be in compliance with the applicable law and be reasonable, appropriate, transparent and accurately recorded. Furthermore, You will affirmatively disclose and obtain advance written consent from Intel any time You contemplate use of MDF in connection with an Activity which will include or involve any Government Official (including, but not limited to, activities which will involve payment of speaking or consulting fees or provision of anything of value to a Government Official). Intel reserves the right to withhold approval for any Activity involving Government Officials that in Intel’s sole discretion does not comport with applicable law or which may raise compliance concerns. If in the course of carrying out an approved Activity You become aware of any previously undisclosed government involvement, You will inform Intel as soon as practicable, and in no case later than Your submission of any associated claim for reimbursement. Intel will determine, in its sole discretion, whether such government involvement comports with applicable law, and reserves the right to deny reimbursement for any payments or other expenses which may raise compliance concerns. 2. Government Official Ownership or Control. You represent and warrant that unless previously disclosed to Intel in writing, none of Your directors, owners, officers, or principals, or any immediate family member of a director, owner, officer, or principal, is a Government Official with influence over the subject of this Agreement. You shall notify Intel in writing within five business days if at any time during the term of this Agreement any of Your directors, owners, officers, or principals is named, appointed, or otherwise becomes a Government Official with influence over the subject of this Agreement. If, in the opinion of Intel, such a change increases the compliance risks related to the Approved Activities, the parties will work together to reach an acceptable solution. If no such solution can be found, such change will constitute grounds for Intel to terminate this Agreement. 3. Customer Contractors With respect to any contractor or third party (“Contractor”) hired by Customer that obtains a User ID on Customer’s behalf, Customer is responsible for: a) obtaining Intel’s prior approval prior to Contractor requesting a User ID, and b) ensuring the Contractor understands and honors the commitments of this Agreement. Notwithstanding, Customer remains responsible for the actions of the Contractor with respect to the System. You further certify that You will ensure that any Contractor or third-party performing services in connection with this Agreement and acting under Your authority or control are aware of and will not violate the Anti-Corruption Laws. Your obligations under these Terms and Conditions extend to all Contractors who may undertake Activities on Your behalf, and noncompliance by any such Contractor will be considered noncompliance by You, and may result in denial of part or all of any associated claim for reimbursement. You further represent and warrant that goods or services that will be reflected in Contractor invoices You intend to submit as POP will in fact have been provided as represented.


16.    Export Regulations. You agree to refrain from exporting, either directly or indirectly, any product, service or technical data or system incorporating such items without first obtaining any required license or other approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce or other applicable agency of the United States Government. If any product is exported from the United States or re-exported from a foreign destination, You will ensure that the distribution and export/re-export or import of the product complies with all laws, regulations, orders, or other restrictions of the U.S. Export Administration Regulations and the appropriate foreign government.


17.    Waivers. The failure of either party to enforce any right resulting from breach of any provision of these Terms and Conditions by the other party will not be deemed to be a waiver of any right relating to a subsequent breach of such provision or any other right.


18.    Assignment. Intel may assign or delegate its rights or obligations, or any part thereof under these Terms and Conditions to Intel Corporation and any of its directly or indirectly majority-owned subsidiaries worldwide. Otherwise, neither party may assign or delegate its rights or obligations under these Terms and Conditions without the prior written consent of the other.


19.    Order of Priority and Full Agreement. The English language version of these Terms and Conditions will prevail over any translations of them. The terms of any trademark license agreement(s) will prevail over these Terms and Conditions with respect to the subject matter of the trademark license agreement. These Terms and Conditions constitute the entire understanding and agreement between You and Intel with regard to the subject matter hereof and supersede all prior agreements, communications, representations and discussions between the parties, whether written or oral. Any contrary of conflicting term is hereby rejected.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, Intel may, in its sole discretion, amend these Terms and Conditions, which will be effective upon notification unless a different time is stated. Posting changes on the System or email notification will be deemed notification to You of such changes. You agree that Your continued participation in, or access to, the System after any changes or modifications, constitutes Your acceptance of the Terms and Conditions as modified. Approved Opportunities which you had already accepted via the System prior to a change, will not be affected, unless You receive an updated Quote Letter.  


21.    Applicable Law. These Terms and Conditions are exclusively governed and construed in accordance with the Governing Law indicated in Section 15 (“Definitions”) of these Terms and Conditions.

Exhibit A - Intel Partner Deal Incentive

 

One of the incentives that may be available to you, at Intel’s discretion, via the System, is the Intel Partner Deal Incentive. 

1.      Framework Details

1.1.            Partner Deal Incentives

·        Company will be eligible to earn an incentive for purchases of Eligible Products per an Approved Eligible Deal (the “Incentive”), as further set forth in    this Exhibit. The Incentive amount will be up to the following per component discount amounts for each Eligible Product as notified by Intel in writing from time to time during the Term.


·        The Incentive cannot be combined with any other rebates or discounts unless approved by Intel in writing.


·        The Incentive will be administered through a flat rate back-end rebate (BER) process on a quarterly basis at the end of the quarter in which the consumption and reporting requirements set forth in this Exhibit are achieved.


·      Company understands and acknowledges that Intel does not control the resale price of Company’s supply line and cannot guarantee the price of Intel products from Company’s supply line. The Incentive is not intended to offset any supply line markup. Company is advised to work with its supply line to obtain a final price quote, prior to purchase.


1.2.            Eligible Products


Eligible Products for the Incentive under the Partner Deal Incentive will be communicated by Intel in writing on a quarterly basis.

Non-SIPP Mobile CPUs for Corporate Market Segment will not be communicated by Intel as Eligible Products. “Corporate Market Segment” means the segment of the market comprised of sales of computer systems to businesses with more than 1,000 employees. “SIPP” means Intel® Stable Image Platform Program which is a key component Intel® vPro™ technology. Details available at: http://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/computer. upgrades/pc-upgrades/sipp-intel-stable-image-platform-program.html? wapkw=sipp. 


1.3.            Eligible Deals

·        Eligible Deals will exceed 500 units, subject to change upon notice by Intel, and must reflect Company’s sales of an Eligible Product per Section 1.2 and Intel’s communication to Company.


·        Eligible Deals will be deals in which Company is selling in response to a competitive request for proposal (RFP) or similar tender process, identified as part of Company’s request for the Incentive.  

 

NOTE: Meeting Intel’s requirement for an Eligible Deal and this Framework does not constitute a guarantee by Intel to offer Company the Incentive for a particular deal. Intel may modify any or all eligibility requirements on a periodic basis upon notice to Company.


1.4.            Deal Registration Process

Intel will approve deals registered as Eligible Deals for the Incentive in its sole discretion. Only deals approved by Intel will be Approved Eligible Deals. Intel will provide to Company, on a quarterly basis, with training regarding the Incentive, including the criteria, the submission process, and the claiming process for Eligible Deals.  Company must, within 90 days of receiving the Quote Letter, update the relevant request to reflect whether the customer of Company that uses or consumes the relevant Intel Products (“End Customer”) specified has awarded the deal to the Company.

1.5.            Approval Period

The term of each Approved Eligible Deal will begin on the “Approved Pricing Start Date,” as identified in the Quote Letter. The term of each Approved Eligible Deal will terminate on the “Approved Pricing End Date” as identified in the Quote Letter, which will not be later than one year after the Approved Pricing Start Date. A Deal Term (between Approved Pricing Start Date and Approved Pricing End Date) may be extended in Intel’s sole discretion upon request by Company.


1.6.            Quote Letter

For each Approved Eligible Deal, Intel will issue to Company a Quote Letter which will contain details of the Approved Eligible Deal, as well as the Incentive which Intel will provide to Company for that Approved Eligible Deal, and Approved Pricing Start and End Dates. Company should refer to the Quote Letter for details of each specific Incentive and retain them for reference when submitting an Incentive Claim under Section 1.7.


1.7.            Incentive Claim and Payment

  • The consumption period will start on Approved Pricing Start Date and will end on the Approved Pricing End Date.
  • Company invoice dates must be within Approved Pricing Start Date and Approved Pricing End Date (i.e. Consumption Period).
  • The claim period will start on Approved Pricing Start Date and will end 30 days after the end of the Intel fiscal quarter in which the Approved Pricing End Date occurs.
  • Company may submit a Consumption Report, in the form and process instructed by Intel, at any time, according to any cadence, during the Claim Period, to receive a rebate payment.
  • If Company fails to submit a Consumption Report during the claim period, Company will be deemed to have automatically waived its right to claim the Incentive under this Exhibit and Intel will have no obligation to pay. 

·        Intel will provide to Company a Quote # and Quote Line # for each Approved Eligible Deal. Company must include Quote # ID on each Consumption Report.

·        Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and without prejudice to any of its rights or remedies, Intel will initiate rebate payments on a quarterly basis, within the first six weeks of Intel’s fiscal quarter. To be eligible for payment, Customer must submit the required reports on time as per the Intel published calendar and must be properly set up in Intel’s payment tools. For the avoidance of doubt, Intel does not guarantee that the Customer will receive such funds within the first six weeks of Intel’s fiscal quarter. 

·        In case Intel fails to pay the Incentive or in the event of this Exhibit on the amount of the Incentive paid by Intel for a specific quarter, Company will seek clarification and appeal in writing to Intel, indicating the specific reasons for the appeal and providing adequate evidence in its support, within a maximum of 30 days from the later of: the date Intel’s payment was made, or the date Intel’s payment was due to be made under this Exhibit. If no appeal is received by Intel in the aforementioned thirty-day period, Company will be deemed to have automatically waived its right to claim the Incentive under this Exhibit for the relevant quarter, and Intel will have no obligation to pay. If an appeal is instead timely submitted, Intel may request Company to provide additional evidence supporting the rejected portion of the claim within 10 days from the request. If the additional evidence is not received by Intel within the ten-day timeframe or if Intel concludes, in its reasonable judgment, to finally reject the claim, Intel will be deemed to have paid the entire amount due for that quarter under this Exhibit. Company acknowledges and agrees that Intel’s decision on the appeal will be final and binding. 

·        Company is entitled to rebates only in the amount agreed to per the terms of the Quote Letter. In cases where Rebates have been mistakenly overpaid by Intel due to an accounting or clerical error, Intel reserves the right to recover overpaid Rebates from Company. In case Company believes to have received an amount in excess of the amount that Company has accrued during the term of this Exhibit, or where Company is aware that the End Customer has returned Eligible Products under an Approved Deal, Company will notify Intel immediately.

·        Intel’s Rebate Payment Policy (as updated from time to time) governs the calculation and payment of all Rebates provided by Intel. Intel’s Rebate Payment Policy is available upon request.

·        The determination and payment of any eventual tax liability (including, but not limited to, value added taxes and sales and use taxes) triggered by the payment of the Incentive, as well as any eventual penalty and interests for non-compliance, will be Company’s sole responsibility. Intel disclaims any liability to this effect.

2.      General Terms

2.1.            Modifications

Intel has the authority to change Eligible Products upon providing a 30-day written notice of such changes. Intel also has the authority to change the rebate per unit upon providing written notice of such changes. 

2.2.            Evidencing Compliance

·        Upon written request, Company will provide Intel with documentation showing Company has complied with the terms and conditions of this Exhibit. Company will provide such documentation no later than 30 days after receipt of the written request. Company will retain original documentation demonstrating compliance for no less than 18 months after the date of relevant transactions. Necessary documentation includes, but is not limited to, sales and shipping invoices evidencing purchases from OEMs. Further, Intel reserves the right at any time to audit compliance and Company agrees to provide Intel (or Intel's authorized representative) access to Company’s relevant books and records (including electronic records) so that Intel can verify compliance with this Exhibit. To the extent Company may be required under local law to obtain the consent of third parties to the disclosure of relevant information for the purposes of complying with this Section, Company warrants to Intel it has or will obtain any necessary consents.

·        If Company is unable to provide supporting documentation (showing compliance with the applicable provisions of this Exhibit) for some or all of the discounts, and/or if Intel determines, in its reasonable judgment, that Company has failed to comply with the terms and conditions of this Exhibit, Intel may take the following actions: a) Intel will send Company a letter noting Company’s failure to provide proper documentation and requiring Company to provide a corrective action plan, and b) if Company fails to implement an effective corrective action plan within 30 days of the notice letter, Intel will withhold, reverse, or disallow any portion/share of the discounts that Company cannot provide evidence of compliance with the terms and conditions of this Exhibit.

2.3.            Non-exclusivity

Rebates, benefits and incentives offered as part of this Framework are not conditioned on any exclusivity or market share commitment. Furthermore, nothing in this Exhibit shall prevent either Intel or Company from entering into similar arrangements with third parties.

2.4.            Entire Exhibit

This Exhibit, along with any Quote Letter, constitutes the entire understanding and Exhibit between Intel and Company with regard to the subject matter hereof and supersede all prior Exhibits, communications, representations and discussions between the parties, whether written or oral regarding the subject matter hereof. Any contrary or conflicting term is hereby rejected.
